{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "maflcko",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "concerned about 500 LOC complexity vs Python, lack of win64 cross-test support with CTest, and CI duplication"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3623201465",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Whether the argument filtering modification is an unrelated change",
      "quote": "Unrelated change?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "Author explained why the handling was needed for direct mode and noted a potential separate bug",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3641442985"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3641442985",
      "status_by_quote": "Not quite, although it was incorrect (thanks!)"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3623206731",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Call the test runner from the build directory instead of adding a new command-line option",
      "quote": "Why not follow the docs and call the test_runner from the build dir, which avoids having to pass the new option?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "Addressed in push by invoking the generated test_runner.py link/copy from the build directory",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3641462805", "rc:4206234229"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4206234229",
      "status_by_quote": "The added runner-level --configfile option is gone."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3623224266",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Drop the change or provide a rationale for resolving the source-tree path and setting PYTHON_GIL",
      "quote": "Could drop this, or add least add a short rationale for stuff like this?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "Author removed the change in latest push",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3641495121", "rc:4206236307"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4206236307",
      "status_by_quote": "now removed."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3685751131",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Exposing CTest execution in CI creates redundant workflows and risks silently ignoring TEST_RUNNER_EXTRA",
      "quote": "not sure about exposing this in CI. This will silently ignore `TEST_RUNNER_EXTRA`, and having two ways to achieve the same seems confusing anyway.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "Author dropped the duplicate selector in CI push",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3711983733", "rc:4206226811"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4206226811",
      "status_by_quote": "Also dropped the duplicate selector."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3713474956",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Adds 500 lines of complex CMake logic when an alternative in Python would be far simpler",
      "quote": "This pull is adding 500 LOC of logic complexity, so my preference would be to at least keep the overhead low. Recall the alternative to this would be to write it in a few trivial lines of Python",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "Author reduced complexity by dropping support for older CMake versions",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4206226811"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4206226811",
      "status_by_quote": "Agreed this change was getting too large. About half was supporting this new feature on old cmake versions, so I dropped that."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3713515684",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "CTest cannot run functional tests for win64 cross builds whereas a Python runner can",
      "quote": "Also, recall that Python would work when testing win64-cross builds, but CTest does not.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "Author acknowledged limitation and deferred win64 cross support to a follow-up",
      "author_replies": ["c:6036847941"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6036847941",
      "status_by_quote": "Windows cross remains a limitation for now. It can be made to work without too much tinkering, but I don't think that's needed in this pull."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3794320300",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Rebase on top of PR 35846 for better error message handling",
      "quote": "You may want to rebase this on top of https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35846, for better error (message) handling",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "maflcko to review updated smaller scope and replies to objections",
      "id": "c:6036847941"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Author pushed an update dropping support for older CMake versions to reduce complexity, dropped the duplicate CI selector, removed the --configfile option, and addressed the win64-cross objection by scoping it out of this PR."
}
